_readme: The curated topic filter for this shard — WHICH Science (AAAS) papers belong in The Lit. `topics` are OpenAlex topic ids (a work matches when ANY of its ~3 assigned topics is listed; ids verified against display_name on every build, warn-only). `searches` are quoted OpenAlex title_and_abstract.search phrases (stemmed, so singular covers plural). `mustInclude` force-adds specific DOIs — the owner's requested papers, immune to topic re-tagging. No excludeDoiPrefixes here: unlike Nature's d41586-* news DOIs, Science front-matter shares the 10.1126/science.* pattern with research papers, so the Crossref type filter (journal-article only) is the guard — Perspectives/Policy Forums that Crossref types as journal-article are listed, like PNAS commentaries. Edit this file and push — the next build re-seeds the scope and harvests the difference. Keep the topics/searches lists in sync with lit-data-nature's scope.json (same curation, two shards).

topics.name: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
